newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS takes Hollinger off under review list.
newsitem.headline: DBRS takes Hollinger off under review list.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said it removed newspaper giant Hollinger Inc from its "under review" list and confirmed its ratings with a stable trend on Friday.
DBRS confirmed Hollinger's Southam-linked convertible debentures at BB, liquid yield options notes at BB (low), First DT Holdings Ltd at Pfd-4 and Premier U.K. NT at Pfd-4, it said.
DBRS had put Hollinger under review with negative implications before it had finalized the purchase of an additional ownership interest in Southam Inc.

DBRS added: "Hollinger's current debt level could be further reduced over the near term as it expects to use proceeds of about US$440 million from the announced sale of the investment in John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, a newspaper group in Australia, to lower the group's consolidated 1997 debt levels."
